name: Agency Dashboard
description: Agency operations dashboard with period switcher: revenue, gross margin delta in points, billable utilisation vs. target, effective hourly rate, stacked per-person utilisation bars with target marker and overbooking flags, and client revenue concentration warnings.

props.name: periods
props.description: { label, revenue, previousRevenue, deliveryCost, previousDeliveryCost, backlog, revenueTrend, team[], clients[] } per period id

props.name: concentrationLimit
props.description: Max healthy revenue share of one client 0–1

usage: Pair with agency-clients and agency-projects for a full agency workspace.
